text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizen with valid ordinary passport. Note: Applicants who emigrated to other countries from the Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan and obtain foreign nationality, and applicants who has acquired foreign nationality automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parent(s) is (are) Chinese citizen(s), should meet the requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC (Click to check). 2. In good physical and mental health; in excellent academic standing and with good conduct; abide by the laws and decrees of China and comply with rules and regulations of Chongqing University. 3. Self-supported applicants should be above 18 years old and under 30 years old. 4. High school graduated or above, meeting the academic requirements of the applied program. 5. Chinese language proficiency: HSK 4 (≥210) or equivalent.
